title: Can I BEAT the Karate Bots?
summary: Plays chess.com's monthly themed karate bots in order: White Belt Dave (450), the Blunder Brothers (800, two characters), Britlin (1350), a fourth bot (~1800), and the Sensei (rating hidden; says 'meow'). Beats the first four (the low bots hand him free queens), loses to the Sensei. He wishes the bots had a gimmick (e.g. Dave karate-chops the board, pieces disappear).
rules: Normal chess vs bots; bot chat lines in character.
